# Autosize

> Autosize constructor.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var Autosize = require( '@stdlib/plot/vega/autosize/ctor' );
```

#### Autosize( \[options] )

Returns an autosize instance.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();
// returns <Autosize>
```

The constructor accepts the following `options`:

-   **contains**: method for determining how a size calculation should be performed. Default: `'content'`.
-   **resize**: boolean indicating whether to re-calculate an autosize layout on every view update. Default: `false`.
-   **type**: autosize method. Default: `'pad'`.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize({
    'contains': 'padding',
    'resize': true,
    'type': 'fit'
});
// returns <Autosize>

var v = autosize.type;
// returns 'fit'
```

* * *

### Writable Properties

<a name="prop-contains"></a>

#### Autosize.prototype.contains

Method for determining how a size calculation should be performed. Default: `'content'`.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();

// Set:
autosize.contains = 'padding';

// Get:
var v = autosize.contains;
// returns 'padding'
```

<a name="prop-resize"></a>

#### Autosize.prototype.resize

Boolean indicating whether to re-calculate an autosize layout on every view update. Default: `false`.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();

// Set:
autosize.resize = true;

// Get:
var v = autosize.resize;
// returns true
```

<a name="prop-type"></a>

#### Autosize.prototype.type

Autosize type. Default: `'pad'`.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();

// Set:
autosize.type = 'none';

// Get:
var v = autosize.type;
// returns 'none'
```

* * *

### Read-only Properties

<a name="prop-properties"></a>

#### Autosize.prototype.properties

List of enumerable properties.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();

var v = autosize.properties;
// returns [ 'contains', 'resize', 'type' ]
```

* * *

### Methods

<a name="method-to-json"></a>

#### Autosize.prototype.toJSON()

Serializes an autosize instance to a JSON object.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize({
    'type': 'fit'
});

var v = autosize.toJSON();
// returns { 'contains': 'content', 'resize': false, 'type': 'fit' }
```

This method is implicitly invoked by `JSON.stringify`.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize({
    'type': 'fit'
});

var str = JSON.stringify( autosize );
// returns '{"contains":"content","resize":false,"type":"fit"}'
```

* * *

### Events

#### 'change'

Emitted whenever a property value changes.

```javascript
var autosize = new Autosize();

autosize.on( 'change', onChange );

autosize.type = 'fit';

function onChange( event ) {
    console.log( 'Updated property: %s', event.property );
}
```

</section>
